constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The supplied reference audio is a low engine rumble.
A weak, directionless ambient wash is the only light in the space, laying a dull grey sheen on the car's front bodywork.

subjects.description: A long, low car seen only as a silhouette at first, its dark bodywork gradually becoming readable as ambient light grazes its nose, grille and headlamp housings.

speakers.description: The car itself: a low, resonant engine rumble that carries no words, used as the vehicle's off-screen voice.

references.description: A low engine rumble used as the timbre and pitch character of the car's engine note throughout the shot sequence.
references.retention_details: Only the tonal character of the supplied rumble is reused as the car's engine voice; nothing else from the source is copied.

description.text: The frame begins in near-total darkness, a field of deep charcoal black with no readable horizon, wall or floor. Only the faintest variation in the gloom suggests depth, as though a wide, unlit space extends far past every edge of the image. Then, low in the frame,

appears as a thin silhouette, its outline barely separable from the surrounding blackness — a long, low body crouched close to the ground. No highlights define its surfaces yet; the shape reads only as a denser absence of light, a soft-edged mass that the eye must hunt for. As the darkness holds, a very faint ambient sheen grazes the leading edge of the front bodywork, picking out one sliver of metal that glints dully and then subsides, leaving the rest of the vehicle swallowed again. The silhouette shifts almost imperceptibly, a suggestion of weight settling forward on its suspension. Everything else in the space stays unlit, uncluttered and still, so that the smallest gleam on that front edge carries the whole image.
A nearly black frame; the
is only a faint, low silhouette with no readable surface detail.
A deep engine throb — the
— rises out of the stillness at low volume.
A dim ambient sheen slides across the leading edge of the
's front bodywork, catching one dull glint before fading.
The

presses forward out of the gloom. Its front end crosses an invisible threshold where a dim, directionless wash of ambient light begins, and for the first time the bodywork becomes readable: broad flat planes of dark paint, a low nose, seams that catch the weak glow along their edges. The light is too faint to reveal real colour, laying only a grey lustre over the surfaces like breath on cold metal. The movement is slow and heavy, a steady creep that carries the whole mass of the machine forward while the darkness behind it stays absolute. Bands of shadow slide across the hood as the nose pushes deeper into the lit zone, and the grille starts to register as a recessed dark rectangle set into the fascia. Behind the advancing car the space remains empty and silent, no fixture and no reflected source, so the light seems to come from nowhere at all.
The
creeps forward and its nose emerges from blackness into a dim ambient wash.
The engine note — the
— deepens slightly as the car takes load, holding a low even pitch.
Shadow bands travel across the hood, and the grille resolves as a recessed dark rectangle in the front fascia.
The last of the shadow falls away from the front of the

. The grille now reads clearly — a broad dark mesh inside a slim surround — and beside it the headlamp housings resolve from flat grey shapes into distinct glassy forms with a faint inner sheen along their lower edges. Fine detail emerges across the nose: the crisp line where the hood meets the fascia, small fixings, the slight curvature of the bumper as it wraps toward the flanks. The vehicle keeps creeping forward at the same deliberate pace, so gradual that the change registers mostly in the light rather than in position. The space around it stays bare and unlit, a soft black field that now serves only as backdrop behind the emerging front end, and the low grey lustre on the paint holds steady without a single hard highlight.
The
's grille and headlamp housings resolve out of shadow into distinct, legible forms.
The rumble — the
— settles into an even, low tone that holds without wavering.
The
continues its slow forward creep, the remaining darkness sliding off its nose and bumper.

soundscape: A low engine rumble carries through the whole sequence, rising from near-silence at the start, deepening under load as the car advances, and settling into an even tone; behind it the space is otherwise almost soundless, with only a faint, hollow air to suggest an unlit enclosure.

summary.text: creeps forward until a dim ambient wash reveals its nose, grille and headlamp housings, accompanied throughout by a low engine rumble.
